exposure: time to therapeutic anticoagulation resumption after delivery
Time to therapeutic anticoagulation resumption after delivery
outcome: Major hemorrhagic complications (requiring transfusion, hospitalization, volume resuscitation, transfer to intensive care unit, or surgery)
Total complications (including major and minor hemorrhagic and wound complications)
cohort: 232 women treated with therapeutic anticoagulation within 96 hours postpartum between 2003 and 2015
finding: Early resumption of therapeutic anticoagulation postpartum, particularly before 9.25 hours for vaginal deliveries and before 15.1 hours for cesarean deliveries, was associated with an increased risk of complications.
mod_finding: Major complications occurred in 8.4% of women who had cesarean deliveries and 6.0% of women who had vaginal deliveries after receiving early postpartum therapeutic anticoagulation.
